title: Counter tape index
statement: For natural numbers $k_K$ and $k_W$, consider $k_K+1+k_W$ tape indices arranged in three consecutive blocks of lengths $k_K$, $1$, and $k_W$. The counter index is the unique index in the middle, namely the index at offset $k_K$ from the beginning.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $k_K$ giving the left block length
Natural number $k_W$ giving the right block length
